description: This Java class implements a Redis-based store for LwM2M model configurations, providing methods to retrieve all configs, add new configs, and remove configs by endpoint.

classes.name: TbRedisLwM2MModelConfigStore
classes.description: A store class for managing LwM2M model configurations in Redis, supporting retrieval, insertion, and deletion.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all LwM2MModelConfig objects stored in Redis matching the MODEL_EP pattern.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a given LwM2MModelConfig object in Redis, keyed by its endpoint.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the configuration associated with the specified endpoint from Redis.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates the Redis key for a given endpoint by concatenating MODEL_EP and the endpoint string.
